'''Neel's hoverbike''' was an inexpensive [[hoverbike]] owned by the [[Myykian]] [[Neel]] on the [[planet]] [[At Attin]] during the [[New Republic Era]].

==Characteristics==
The [[hoverbike]] was an inexpensive recreation speeder owned by the [[Myykian]] [[Neel]]<ref name="DB" /> on the [[planet]] [[At Attin]] during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="Real Adventure">{{SkeletonCrew|This Could Be a Real Adventure}}</ref> It was 1.04 [[meter]]s long, 0.75 meters wide, 0.77 meters high and was decorated with red streamers from the handlebars.<ref name="DB" />

==History==
[[File:NeelsHoverbike-SC-RealAdventure.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Neel with his hoverbike]]
Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> after taking the [[Career Assessment Test]], Neel is asked by his [[human]] friend [[Wim]] to accompany him to explore [[Onyx Cinder|what he believed might be]] a [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] in a ravine in the [[forest]]. After retrieving [[shovel]]s from [[Neel's home|Neel's garage]] the boys walked their bikes through the forest.<ref name="Real Adventure" />

The two later rode their bikes through [[Unidentified city (At Attin)|the city]] during the [[Invasion of At Attin]], this time joined by Wim's father [[Wendle]] on a [[Bonjj Phalfa's hoverbike|borrowed bike]]. [[Silvo's pirates]] pursued the trio as they raced along the halls of [[At Attin Middle School Gamma]]. One dropship shot through the building's windows and hit Neel's hoverbike, sending the boy flying. The bike was destroyed, but its rider was uninjured; he rolled away and continued to fight the [[pirate]]s.<ref name="Good Guys">{{SkeletonCrew|The Real Good Guys}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The hoverbike first appeared in "[[This Could Be a Real Adventure]],"<ref name="Real Adventure" /> the first episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which aired on [[December 2]], [[2024]].<ref name="Early">{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-premiere-date|text=''Star Wars: Skeleton Crew'' Will Debut Early|date=2024-11-26}}</ref>
